text: from his birth, all the way throughout his life. And this was from the wisdom and the [[hikmah|حكمة]] of Allah [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سبحانه وتعالى]].
So after this period of two years was over, what the... the women of [[Banu Sa'd|بني سعد]] who had these children that they would take from [[Makkah|مكة]],
after two years, they would go back to [[Makkah|مكة]] to return the children to their parents. Because the milk period is over after two years.
So they would go back to [[Makkah|مكة]], and they would return these children to the parents. And usually the parents would give these mothers...
some type of a gift as a token of their appreciation for taking care of their children for this period of time.
So after the two years, the women from [[Banu Sa'd|بني سعد]], they were going back into [[Makkah|مكة]] to return those children to the parents.
And [[Halimah|حليمة]], she went with them to [[Makkah|مكة]] as well. But her intention was not to return [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ.

Her intention in going to [[Makkah|مكة]] was not to return [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ to [[Aminah|آمنة]], because she saw the blessings that came to her family in those two years because this boy was with them.
And she wanted to retain those blessings for as long as she possibly could.

So she went to [[Makkah|مكة]] with the rest of those mothers, but her intention was to try her best to convince [[Aminah|آمنة]], the mother of [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ, to allow her to keep [[Muhammad|محمد]] ﷺ for a longer time.
So she went to [[Aminah|آمنة]], and she said, "Let me keep this boy for a longer period of time."
And then [[Aminah|آمنة]] said, "He is my son. I want to keep him close to me."

And then [[Halimah|حليمة]] said to [[Aminah|آمنة]], "You know, he is like my son, too. You know, I gave him from my milk, and I took care of him for these two years. Let me keep him for a little longer."
"You know how [[Makkah|مكة]] is. The [[hujjaj|حجاج]] are coming in. They come with all sorts of illnesses, all sorts of diseases."
"You know, if I keep him a little bit longer, then he can remain safe from these things. Let me just keep him for a longer period of time."
So with the insistence of [[Halimah|حليمة]], [[Aminah|آمنة]] agreed to allow her son [[Muhammad|محمد]] ﷺ to go back with [[Halimah|حليمة]] into the desert.
And of course, [[Halimah|حليمة]] and her family were very happy about this.
So [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ, this two-year-old boy, he goes back with his foster mother, [[Halimah|حليمة]], into the desert, and he stays among the tribe of [[Banu Sa'd|بني سعد]].
A few months later, just a few months after this conversation between [[Halimah|حليمة]] and [[Aminah|آمنة]],
a very amazing incident happened in the desert with [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ.
So [[Halimah|حليمة]] and her husband, [[al-Harith|الحارث]], they were sitting one day in their tent.
And you can just try to picture the type of life that they used to live. It was in the middle of the desert. They had their tents where they used to stay.
So [[Halimah|حليمة]] and her husband, [[al-Harith|الحارث]], are sitting together in their tent. The children are outside playing.

And as we mentioned, [[Halimah|حليمة]] [[radiyallahu 'anha|رضي الله عنها]], she had a son, a biological son who was around the same age as [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ, and she actually fed these two children together.
So while [[Halimah|حليمة]] and her husband were sitting in the tent one day, [[Halimah|حليمة]]'s son, her biological son, he comes running and screaming and panicked, running towards the tent.
So [[Halimah|حليمة]] and her husband, [[al-Harith|الحارث]], the parents of this boy, they run out of the tent to see what has happened to their child.
And the child, he's screaming, and he's panicked, and he has that look of being terrified in his face.

So [[Halimah|حليمة]] asks her son, "What happened, my son? What happened?" And then he says, "[[akhi|أخي]] [[Muhammad|محمد]]! [[akhi|أخي]] [[Muhammad|محمد]]! My brother [[Muhammad|محمد]]! My brother [[Muhammad|محمد]]!"
And they ask him, "What happened to your brother [[Muhammad|محمد]]? What happened to him? Tell us."
And he says that two men with white clothes, they came to him, and they threw him onto the ground, and they ripped open his chest.
So [[Halimah|حليمة]], she heard this, and she became very scared.
So she runs to where the Prophet ﷺ, or [[Muhammad|محمد]] ﷺ, was.
She runs over there as fast as she can, and she sees [[Muhammad|محمد]] ﷺ, he's fine, but he has a very, very scared look on his face, that something terrifying just happened.
So she runs up to him, and she hugs him. She holds him close to her.
And she asks him, "What happened? What happened?"
And [[Muhammad|محمد]] ﷺ, this two-year-old boy, who is very clear in his speech, he explains to her what happened.
He said, "Two men with white clothes, they came, and they threw me down onto the ground, and they ripped open my chest."
And later on, many years later, the Prophet ﷺ would narrate this incident to his [[sahabah|صحابة]].
Years later, he narrated this incident to his [[sahabah|صحابة]].
And of course, by that time he was a prophet of Allah receiving revelation from Allah, so he knew that those two men who he thought were men who came down, they were actually two angels.
So he explained that two angels came down—he's explaining this many years later to his [[sahabah|صحابة]]—two angels came down, and they threw me onto the ground,
and they split open my chest, and they took out my heart.
And they washed my heart in a gold vessel with [[Zamzam|زمزم]] water.
And then they removed a small black piece and threw it, and they said, "This is the [[Shaytan|شيطان]]'s share of you."
So now that they threw it, the [[Shaytan|شيطان]] has no share in the Prophet ﷺ.
Then they put my heart back into my chest, and then they stitched up my chest.
And the companions of [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ, when they would see his chest, they could see those stitches still there.
They could see the effects of those stitches still in his chest.
And this was from the signs that [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ was truly a messenger of Allah.

So this was the terrifying incident that happened to [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ just a few months after [[Halimah|حليمة]] insisted that [[Aminah|آمنة]] allow her to take [[Muhammad|محمد]] ﷺ back to stay with her in the desert.
So after this incident happened, and after [[Muhammad|محمد]] ﷺ explained to [[Halimah|حليمة]] what happened to him,
[[Halimah|حليمة]] and her husband, they became very worried. They were afraid, what happened to this boy? What is the meaning of this?
And they feared that maybe this was the work of the [[jinn|جن]], that the [[jinn|جن]] had come.
And they feared that he would be harmed by the [[jinn|جن]], and they didn't want to take any responsibility for him possibly being harmed in this way.
They were not his actual parents, and they feared that his mother would blame them if any harm came to him.
So they went back to [[Makkah|مكة]] again with [[Muhammad|محمد]] ﷺ to return him to his mother.
So when they went back into [[Makkah|مكة]]—this was just a few months later after this initial conversation of [[Halimah|حليمة]] asking [[Aminah|آمنة]] to allow her to bring him back—
so a few months later, they go back into [[Makkah|مكة]] again, and they're saying, "We want to give your son back to you."
So now [[Aminah|آمنة]] is confused. She's saying, "Just a few months ago, you came, and I wanted to take him back, but you insisted that you wanted him with you."
"And now, just a few months later, you're telling me to take him back? What happened? Did something happen to my son?"
"Did something happen to my son that you want me to take him back now?"
And they said, "No, no, nothing happened. We're just, you know, we just don't want him to get sick, and, you know, we want to return him to you in a state where he's healthy."

And then she said, "No, there is something. There is no way that you could have taken a 180-degree turn like that in just a few months. Something happened to my son, and I need you to tell me what happened."
So finally, they explain to the mother of [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ about the incident of the splitting of his chest.
So the mother of [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ, [[Aminah|آمنة]], she looks at her little boy, and she sees actually, yes, he has this scar on his chest. Something really did happen.
Then she said to [[Halimah|حليمة]] and her husband, "You are afraid of the [[jinn|جن]] affecting this boy? You are afraid that this boy can be harmed by the [[jinn|جن]]?"
"[[Wallahi|والله]], there is nothing for you to fear in this regard. He will never be affected by the [[shayatin|شياطين]] or the [[jinn|جن]]."
"You know, when I was giving birth to him, just before I gave birth to him, I had a dream that with him coming out, there was a light..."
